hook: Tap your Apple Watch, and keep every word.
hookText: Hinokoe: tap your watch to record

beats.say: Hinokoe, now on the App Store, records conversations from your Apple Watch. Your iPhone transcribes them and labels who said what.
Audio is never uploaded to the developer's servers. Your text records back up to your own encrypted iCloud, and you can keep the last thirty days of audio.
Recording and transcription stay free after a seven-day trial. AI organizing is a one-time 9.99 dollar unlock. It needs iOS 26.
